WITH district_counts AS (
  SELECT 
    a.district_id,
    COUNT(*) as client_count
  FROM disp d
  JOIN account a ON d.account_id = a.account_id
  GROUP BY a.district_id
),
region_totals AS (
  SELECT 
    dist.A3 as region,
    SUM(dc.client_count) as region_total
  FROM district_counts dc
  JOIN district dist ON dc.district_id = dist.district_id
  GROUP BY dist.A3
),
grand_total AS (
  SELECT SUM(client_count) as overall_total FROM district_counts
)
SELECT 
  dc.district_id,
  dist.A3,
  dc.client_count,
  dc.client_count * 1.0 / rt.region_total as share_of_region,
  dc.client_count * 1.0 / gt.overall_total as share_of_overall
FROM district_counts dc
JOIN district dist ON dc.district_id = dist.district_id
JOIN region_totals rt ON dist.A3 = rt.region
CROSS JOIN grand_total gt
ORDER BY share_of_overall DESC
LIMIT 10
